roles.title: Program Manager
roles.description: Own global packaging programs and multi-region product launches, coordinating Finance, Operations, Supply Chain and Ecommerce stakeholders on schedules, KPIs and 3PL and ERP initiatives.
highlights: Own delivery of $2M global packaging programs, aligning scope, requirements, stakeholders, governance, and performance across functions
Directed multi-region product launches across three fulfillment centers in North America, Italy, and Netherlands, ensuring operational readiness
Approved scope modifications across 3 workstreams supporting 3PL integration initiatives and warehouse management system connectivity
Established KPIs and Power BI dashboards, reducing packaging obsolescence 7% while improving inventory visibility, fulfillment, and forecasting
Led SQL and Power BI forecasting, inventory optimization, and ERP enhancements, reducing excess inventory 15% and supporting 10K+ records

roles.title: Associate Program Manager
roles.description: Supported $3.5M feedstock programs and launch readiness through reporting requirements, supplier management and S&OP analysis.
highlights: Defined reporting requirements, business processes, and functional specifications supporting $3.5M feedstock programs and launch readiness
Resolved supplier lead-time disruptions by identifying alternate sourcing strategies, onboarding replacement vendors, and preserving timelines
Automated weekly Excel-based supply chain reporting workflows, reducing processing time from five hours to less than ten minutes
Improved order accuracy 20% by streamlining automated reporting processes and strengthening supply chain planning and execution visibility
Reduced revenue-impacting delays 18% through analysis of production, inventory, and demand-planning requirements supporting decisions

roles.title: Supply Chain Product Analyst
roles.description: Built KPI dashboards and supported S&OP with demand, capacity and supplier-performance analysis.
highlights: Developed SQL and Power BI dashboards for KPI monitoring, improving process efficiency by 12% through performance insights
Supported S&OP through demand analysis, capacity-planning inputs, forecasting reviews, and operational reporting for decision-making
Delivered procurement and supplier-performance analyses that identified improvement opportunities and contributed to a 10% cost reduction
Improved supplier lead times by 15% through performance analysis, procurement insights, and targeted supply chain improvement initiatives
Consolidated operational reporting to improve visibility into sales, operations, demand, and capacity-planning performance
